bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 100 日均线，仍低于 $171.7

read.en: Palantir fell 0.2% on Nov 10 to $168.82, trading $164.00–169.34. It is above the 5-day ($165.0), 100-day ($165.1) and 200-day ($153.5) and below the 10-day ($175.6) and 30-day ($189.7); only the 100-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($178.05), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Palantir 11月10日下跌 0.2%，收于 $168.82，盘中区间 $164.00–169.34。股价位于 5 日（$165.0）、100 日（$165.1）和 200 日（$153.5）均线上方，10 日（$175.6）和 30 日（$189.7）均线下方；仅 100 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$178.05），RSI 为 39。

read.en: No level changed: the $164 low dipped just under the $164.6–165.1 support (5 and 100-day, Sep 10 low) but the close held above it, and the $169.34 high stayed under $170.8–171.7. Resistance is $170.8–171.7, then $175.6–178.3 (10-day, SAR, Nov 2 close) and $184.5 (Oct 16 low). Support is $164–165.1, then $156.3–158.3 and $152.6–153.5. A close above $171.7 would target $175.6–178; below $164, $157–158.
